title: Warm Spicy Yucatecan Pork Tacos
description: This dish features tender, slow-cooked pork, juicy pineapple, and a hint of spicy heat, all wrapped in a warm tortilla.

ingredients.name: boneless pork shoulder
ingredients.notes: preferably with the fat cap intact

ingredients.name: pineapple chunks
ingredients.notes: canned or fresh, whichever is available

instructions: Season the pork shoulder with kosher salt and black pepper, then sear it in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
Remove the pork from the pot and set it aside, then add the diced red onion to the pot and cook until translucent.
Add the pineapple chunks, horseradish, and lime juice to the pot, then stir to combine.
Return the pork to the pot and add enough chicken broth to cover the meat, then bring the mixture to a simmer.
Transfer the pot to the oven and braise the pork for 2.5 to 3 hours, or until tender and easily shredded with a fork.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Shred the cooked pork with two forks and stir in some of the juices from the pot, then season with additional salt and pepper if needed.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the pork onto a warmed tortilla, then topping with diced avocado, sliced radish, and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
Serve the tacos immediately, with additional lime wedges and horseradish on the side for added flavor.
